issues.issue: Whether the wife's affidavit and the appellant's affidavit are admissible as new evidence
issues.applicant_position: He intends to submit a wife's affidavit supporting his sexual orientation; affidavit critiques the RPD.
issues.result_text: Affidavit is not new evidence under IRPA; treated only as supplementary submissions; no wife's affidavit is on record.

issues.issue: Whether an oral hearing should be held before the RAD
issues.applicant_position: He requests an oral hearing before the RAD.
issues.result_text: No admissible new evidence to justify an oral hearing in this case.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD was biased against the appellant
issues.applicant_position: RPD decided he was unworthy of protection and dismissed evidence arbitrarily; bias alleged.
issues.result_text: No material evidence of bias after review of the record; questioning was respectful and within the SOGIE guidelines.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD's credibility findings on sexual orientation were properly made
issues.applicant_position: RPD ignored evidence and reasoned speculatively; errors in paragraphs 6-22 undermine the whole analysis.
issues.result_text: RPD did not err; credibility concerns from inconsistencies, delay and marriage evidence were determinative.
